 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Tile a square grid with its clockwise rotations in a 2x2 arrangement.

    The lower-left quadrant is the 180-degree rotation and the lower-right
    quadrant is the counterclockwise rotation, matching the demonstrated ARC
    transformation.
    """
    def rotate_clockwise(g):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*g[::-1])]

    clockwise = rotate_clockwise(grid)
    half_turn = rotate_clockwise(clockwise)
    counterclockwise = rotate_clockwise(half_turn)

    top = [left + right for left, right in zip(grid, clockwise)]
    bottom = [left + right for left, right in zip(counterclockwise, half_turn)]
